title: CB1--CB7: actual complementary integral basis, count and Cartan multiplication
status: Human mathematical reconstruction with exact pinned source records; no Lean build or whole-proof verification claim.

claims.result: Generic column-invariant polynomials have interlaced column-lex leading exponent arrays.
claims.status: Proved over every integral domain by merged-pair grading, the x=1,y=-t specialization and row induction.

claims.result: The actual dualWeyl module has a monic minor-product integral basis indexed by ssIdx, homogeneous in row weights and valid over every domain.
claims.status: Proved constructively by sorted tableau rows, diagonal leading terms and terminating integral leading-term subtraction; no standard-monomial theorem imported.

claims.result: #ssIdx=D_k(lambda), and dimV equals the product of D_k over positions, discharging FewBadOrbits.
claims.status: Proved by removing the largest entry and an explicit discrete Vandermonde determinant identity. Distinct from selected-symbol density.

claims.result: The actual even/odd selected array family has count n2=product_T D_(k-1)(tail) product_notT D_k(lambda0).
claims.status: Proved by explicit delete/insert bijections and parity/shift invariance; selected tensor products form a direct summand.

claims.result: Exact complementary dimension ratio gives source top_count and count_of_exact under WeightHyp and nonnegative product factor.
claims.status: Proved by the explicit product ratio and product(1-u)>=1-sum u; a slightly sharper k-1 local cost is recorded but the source k is retained downstream.

claims.result: Integral Cartan multiplication spans nabla_(nu+mu); primitive factors have primitive product over a DVR.
claims.status: Proved by partitioning minor factors of each height and by saturated coefficient reduction. No field-only surjectivity substituted.

claims.result: The bases, complementary family and Cartan span transport to the exact H0/Hten/Re lattices, with inverse-basis, signed determinant and w^(-Ar) conventions.
claims.status: Proved using the explicit coordinate isomorphism and additivity; actual midpoint matrices supplied by the prior EL argument. Exact source OntoAll is obtained.
